metadata.description: Agent Skills for VLM Run visual AI: the Orion agent (`vlmrun chat`) for multi-step image, video and document tasks, and the Gateway (`vlmrun gw`) for OCR, VLM chat, embeddings, transcription and System One decisions

plugins.name: vlmrun-cli-skill
plugins.description: Use the VLM Run CLI (`vlmrun chat`) to run the Orion visual AI agent on images, videos, documents and audio: image and video generation and editing, detection, OCR and extraction, video summaries, and stateful sessions with artifacts. Routes one-model gateway work (OCR, VLM chat, embeddings, transcription, System One) to `vlmrun gw` and the vlmrun-gw skill.

plugins.name: mm-cli-skill
plugins.description: Use the mm CLI to index, explore, query, and extract content from multimodal directories containing images, videos, PDFs, code, and other files. Supports file discovery, content extraction, text/semantic search, token counting, and LLM-powered descriptions.

plugins.name: vlmrun-gw
plugins.description: Call VLM Run Gateway models with the `vlmrun gw` CLI, the OpenAI SDK, `VLMRun().gateway`, the MCP server or HTTP: OCR and document parsing, VLM chat over images, video and PDFs, detection, segmentation and pose, embeddings, transcription, file uploads, and typed decisions (System One, `POST /decisions`). Also the `VLMRun` client for platform predictions and agent executions. One self-contained SKILL.md: models by task, commands, knobs, response shapes, cost, limits and errors.
